name: Negros Speedcubing Open III 2018

venue.name: [CityMall Goldenfields](http://citymall.com.ph/Goldenfields,%20Bacolod.htm)
venue.address: Goldenfield South Side, Bacolod City Negros Occidental

information: This is the third installed of Negros Speedcubing Open considered as the yearly anniversary celebration of the birth of speedcubing in the province of Negros Occidental. Only 3x3x3 events will be held at this competition.
